automation_scenarios.description: Create session degrades gracefully when the Gopay call times out

step_descriptions.action: Create a session passing a valid invite_social_group_id while Gopay times out

test_data.description: Restaurant enabled for GoFood group order, max_participants 8

test_data_output.identification_notes: get_supported_category returned zero candidates for the MERCHANT domain (a genuine no-match, not merely uncorroborated) against signals GoFood merchant / Group order enabled / max_participants. get_supported_operation likewise returned an empty operation list for this domain+description; the closest candidates in the live catalog (handle_merchant_info, gomerchant_get_merchant_info, handle_close_open_restaurant) are read-only or unrelated to enabling group-order support or setting a participant cap. MERCHANT has no populated knowledge bundle yet (references/index.md), so this identification cannot exceed medium confidence even if a category existed.

test_data.description: Host customer with a GoPay account who is the ACTIVE OWNER of a GOTO social group with 3 ACTIVE members

test_data_output.identification_notes: Matcher proposed CUSTOMER_WITH_GO_PAY based solely on the GoPay signal (candidates included CUSTOMER_WITH_SUBSCRIPTION, CUSTOMER_WITH_GOCORP, CUSTOMER_WITH_CC, CUSTOMER_WITH_30K_STATUS_STAR, CUSTOMER_WITH_SAVED_ADDRESS_POI/AOI, CUSTOMER_WITH_GO_PAY_COINS, CUSTOMER_WITH_PARTIAL_GO_PAY_COINS[_WALLET/_CC]); rejected under the validation gate because GOTO/FAMILY social-group ownership and membership state is entity state to be created, not a pool-selection attribute, and no token in the category name corroborates 'Social Group' / group type / role / membership-status signals. Operation catalog search (signals: Social Group, GOTO, Owner, Active Member) returned only group-order-SESSION operations (handle_group_order_create / _join / _leave / _remove_member / _mark_ready / _make_booking, all operationSource=pertamax) — none creates or attaches a persistent social group with a specified ownership/membership state. FIX-GOFOODSG-021's description implies social groups may be auto-generated by the system after a completed booking, which could be a viable provisioning path, but this is not an exposed TestBuddy/Pertamax operation and must be confirmed with the TDP/dev team before use.
